## What you'll master

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-6}
### 🧠 Tensor mechanics & memory layouts

- Master multi-dimensional indexing, slicing, axis transpositions, and strided memory buffers.
- Understand zero-copy views and memory layouts in NumPy, PyTorch, and JAX.
:::
::: {.g-col-6}
### 📉 Low-rank tensor compression

- Factorize high-dimensional tensors into compact factor matrices using CP/PARAFAC and Tucker decompositions.
- Reduce storage and computational overhead while preserving critical latent structures.
:::
::: {.g-col-6}
### 🔍 Real-world data diagnostics

- Identify and repair spatial and temporal anomalies, constant or dead pixels, and scale imbalances.
- Impute missing values across complex multi-way arrays, including NYC taxi grids, airline trends, and image sets.
:::
::: {.g-col-6}
### ⚡ Hardware acceleration & infrastructure

- Connect abstract tensor contractions to GPUs, TPUs, Tensor Cores, and BLAS/LAPACK backends.
- Build intuition for memory bandwidth bottlenecks and hardware execution.
:::
:::

## The 210-minute journey

| Module | Time | Focus |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 00:00–00:45 | **Shapes & strides** — reshaping, indexing, broadcasting, and zero-copy views |
| 2 | 00:45–01:30 | **Systems & convolutions** — tensor equations, multi-way filtering, and multidimensional transformations |
| 3 | 01:30–02:30 | **Factorization & compression** — low-rank CP and Tucker decompositions, with memory reduction |
| 4 | 02:30–03:30 | **Diagnostics & imputation** — dead pixels, scale anomalies, and missing-value recovery |

## What this is

Master the multidimensional math behind modern machine learning. Learn to manipulate, compress, and diagnose multi-way datasets and model weights in a focused, 3-hour interactive workshop.

Work with images, taxi trips, and airline counts. Find missing values, uneven
scales, and constant pixels. Small synthetic examples explain selected ideas.

No tensor theory is required. New terms are explained as they appear.

## Prerequisites

The tools are free and run in your browser.

::: {.callout-tip icon=false}
## Am I ready for this workshop?

If you can multiply two matrices and understand basic SVD, you are ready! No prior tensor theory is required. We build every high-dimensional concept step-by-step using code and real data.
:::

**Do before the session**

- Review the linear algebra in **{{< var workshop.book >}}**: vectors,
  matrices, products, inverses, eigendecomposition, and SVD.
- **[`linear-algebra-deep-learning`]({{< var workshop.prereq_repo_url >}})** —
  required pre-work. Complete 14 bilingual notebooks, from vectors to PCA.
  Allow 2–3 hours.
- **[Notebook 00]({{< var repo.colab_base >}}/00-setup-and-data.ipynb), run in
  Colab** — check setup and data downloads. Report any errors before the session.

**Recommended**

- **[*Essence of linear algebra*]({{< var workshop.prereq_video_url >}})**
  (3Blue1Brown) — a visual refresher. 16 videos, about 3 hours.

**Have ready on the day**

- **[Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/)** for coding.
- **Discord** for questions and group work. The facilitator shares the invite.
- **A phone or second tab for [Kahoot](kahoot.qmd)**. Join with the session PIN.

## How we work

- **Exercise blocks** — 10 minutes coding, then 5 minutes explanation.
- **Group blocks** — 10 minutes discussion in your breakout channel, then share-back.

## A note on language

Teaching is in English. **Ask questions in English or Spanish.**
The [slides](slides/es/index.qmd) and notebooks support both languages.
